title: Listen and Choose a Best Response

sources.label: ETS TOEFL iBT Student Practice Test 1
ETS TOEFL iBT Student Practice Test 2

questions.speaker: Woman
questions.promptTranscript: Didn’t I just see you in the library an hour ago?
choices: As a matter of fact, I was returning a book.
Yes, you can find it in the reference section.
I don’t think I’ll have enough time to do that.
Actually, I think I can get there a little earlier.
questions.explanation: 回答说明刚才确实在图书馆还书，直接回应了确认式问句。

questions.speaker: Man
questions.promptTranscript: Where is the nearest bus stop?
choices: I can help you find it.
questions.explanation: 对方询问地点，提出帮助找到车站是四个选项中唯一合适的回应。

questions.speaker: Woman
questions.promptTranscript: How do I contact customer service?
choices: Yes, you're allowed to do that.
questions.explanation: How 询问联系方式，使用聊天功能给出了具体方法。

questions.speaker: Woman
questions.promptTranscript: I'm afraid I'm not available this evening.
questions.explanation: 对方今晚没空，改约明晚是自然的后续回应。

questions.speaker: Man
questions.promptTranscript: Isn't the post office open today?
choices: I think he's come home already.
questions.explanation: 说话人不确定营业情况，查询在线时间表最能解决问题。

questions.speaker: Woman
questions.promptTranscript: If you need me, just text.
choices: I can help you with that.
You don't need any more information.
You have a lot of questions, don't you?
You haven't given me your number yet.
questions.explanation: 要发短信必须先有号码，因此指出还没有号码最符合语境。

questions.speaker: Woman
questions.promptTranscript: So the store is open for business all weekend?
choices: Yes, there is a major power outage.
Yes, it's closed all day on Sunday.
Yes, they're having a huge sale.
questions.explanation: 周末大型促销与商店持续营业相符，其他选项都与 open 矛盾。

questions.speaker: Man
questions.promptTranscript: Did you attend the seminar?
questions.explanation: 睡过头可以合理解释为什么没有参加研讨会。

questions.speaker: Woman
questions.promptTranscript: Who is the new manager?
choices: I’m unsure, but I can find out.
questions.explanation: Who 询问身份；不知道但可以去确认，是唯一直接回应身份问题的选项。

questions.speaker: Man
questions.promptTranscript: When is the due date for the report?
choices: Please wait while I look that up.
No, I have another due date.
questions.explanation: When 询问截止日期，先查找日期是自然回应。

questions.speaker: Man
questions.promptTranscript: I’m going to get some groceries.
choices: The cinema is not open today.
questions.explanation: 对方要去买食品，提议一起去最符合对话衔接。

questions.speaker: Woman
questions.promptTranscript: Would you like a copy of my notes?
choices: The break is in an hour.
questions.explanation: Would you like 表示提供，接受并表示感谢是最自然的回应。

questions.speaker: Man
questions.promptTranscript: Sami and Layla are on their way to the café.
questions.explanation: 听到朋友正去咖啡馆，询问是否一起加入最符合情境。

questions.speaker: Woman
questions.promptTranscript: I'd like to hear your thoughts on the job candidates.
choices: I’ll set up a meeting for us to talk.
questions.explanation: 对方想讨论候选人，安排会议正好承接这一请求。

questions.speaker: Woman
questions.promptTranscript: How much does expedited shipping cost?
questions.explanation: 询问加急配送费用时，说明不提供该服务是完整且相关的回答。

questions.speaker: Man
questions.promptTranscript: How can I get this light to work?
choices: The lighter one is over there.
There's a switch on the back wall.
I prefer to work at home.
questions.explanation: How 询问让灯工作的办法，指出墙上的开关直接提供方法。

questions.speaker: Woman
questions.promptTranscript: I'm not available tomorrow.
choices: Let's try to get there early.
What's a better day for you?
It's not on my schedule either.
I was in a meeting last night.
questions.explanation: 对方明天没空，询问更合适的日期是自然的改约方式。

questions.speaker: Man
questions.promptTranscript: The campus talent contest will be held next Saturday evening.
choices: I can hold that for you.
Stage lighting is usually very hot.
My roommate is a talented basketball player.
Do you know who the judges will be?
questions.explanation: 得知才艺比赛时间后，询问评委信息是与比赛最相关的回应。

questions.speaker: Man
questions.promptTranscript: What time do I need to pick up Michael from the train station?
choices: Don't worry about it--I'll get him.
He said he prefers the window seat.
The station now has a snack shop.
There's road construction near the entrance.
questions.explanation: 主动提出代为接人，直接解决了询问接站时间背后的需求。

questions.speaker: Woman
questions.promptTranscript: Isn't the grocery store open late tonight?
questions.explanation: 否定疑问句在确认营业时间，Yes, it is 直接确认商店会晚关门。

questions.speaker: Woman
questions.promptTranscript: Did you bring the identification documents?
choices: They are in the blue folder.
questions.explanation: 说明文件在蓝色文件夹中，既表明带来了也交代了位置。

questions.speaker: Man
questions.promptTranscript: Wait, isn't the concert tomorrow night?
questions.explanation: 说话人在核对日期，纠正为今晚是唯一直接且合乎语法的回答。

questions.speaker: Woman
questions.promptTranscript: I'm not available this afternoon.
questions.explanation: 对方说明下午没空，表示理解是最得体的回应。

questions.speaker: Woman
questions.promptTranscript: Who is responsible for the project timeline?
questions.explanation: Who 询问负责人；表示不确定是语法和语义都合理的回应。

questions.speaker: Woman
questions.promptTranscript: Why did the team meeting get canceled?
questions.explanation: 对方以为会议取消了，纠正为改期是最符合语境的信息。

questions.speaker: Man
questions.promptTranscript: Can you assist me with my science report?
choices: Let me know what you think.
What exactly do you need help with?
questions.explanation: 面对求助，询问具体需要哪方面帮助最自然。

questions.speaker: Man
questions.promptTranscript: I'm not sure about the current plan.
questions.explanation: 对方表达对计划的不确定，表示遗憾是四项中唯一得体的回应。

questions.speaker: Man
questions.promptTranscript: If you need help, ask Ms. Johnson.
questions.explanation: 对建议作出接受回应，表示会照做最自然。

questions.speaker: Woman
questions.promptTranscript: What time does the event start?
questions.explanation: What time 需要具体时间，At 1 p.m. 直接回答。

questions.speaker: Man
questions.promptTranscript: Who is hosting the party tonight?
questions.explanation: Who 询问主办者，The marketing team is 直接给出主体。
